judged.question: Were the firm's contracts with NimbusCloud and PayCore Ltd in place before 1 January 2027, and when does each next renew?
judged.why_unknown: The firm table gives each contract's end date (30 June 2027 and 31 December 2029) but not when it was made or when it renews.
judged.impact: Sets the date by which each contract must meet paragraph 6.3 under paragraph 9.3.

answer: Both contracts were made in 2024, before 1 January 2027; neither renews before its end date.
